query:
UPDATE contract_change_orders SET status = $4,
              approved_by = COALESCE($5, approved_by),
              approved_at = COALESCE($6, approved_at),
              billed_invoice_id = COALESCE($7, billed_invoice_id),
              updated_at = now()
           WHERE org_id = $1 AND contract_id = $2 AND id = $3
